assertion_analysis.changed identity and remote-missing asse: Reverting mismatch handling or the remote missing branch returns None and loses the literal node-disk-unreadable kind.
assertion_analysis.configuration (:444-452): Changing the default fails literal 180; ignoring the override fails literal 17; accepting zero fails the ValueError context; the override equality measures setting plumbing rather than time expiry.
assertion_analysis.disappearing fleet (:500): Restoring the sample-is-None fallthrough loses the node-disk-unreadable hold.
assertion_analysis.expiry boundary (:352-364): Roundtrip equality to the written sample is a positive acceptance control only; unconditional refusal fails it, while ignoring or hardcoding the age bound fails the paired raises at max_age+1 for 17 and 180 seconds.
assertion_analysis.extended named/service hold test (:250-2: Removing the selection gate loses held ids and recorded verdicts; equality against injected pressure/reason is propagation coverage only, not independent measurement, and is not counted as freshness proof.
assertion_analysis.fresh positive control (:372-373): An unconditional hold or rejecting all remote data fails the explicit None assertions on a current healthy reading.
assertion_analysis.invalid data (:409): Restoring identity, timestamp, metric or reserve acceptance makes the corresponding damaged healthy record return no hold rather than node-disk-unreadable.
assertion_analysis.obligation readers (:428-437): Reader disagreement fails parity; joint omission would pass parity but fails the separate literal one-kind list, so parity alone is not credited as an independent guard.
assertion_analysis.queued refusal and recovery (:480-492): Restoring fail-open launches the first request and fails held/empty-launch/queued assertions; permanent refusal fails the second launch; returned-id equality is routing coverage and the observed launch callback adds an independent effect.
assertion_analysis.unavailable cases (:334-340): Restoring fail-open makes missing/unreadable/expired-free return None; disabling expiry leaves expired-low as node-disk-reserve, contradicting the independently selected expected kind.
